ai_review.summary: Unknown source recording of the famed Feb 14 1968 second set—red‑hot performance featuring New Potato Caboose, The Other One and other classics.
ai_review.review: The release captures a legendary second set from February 14, 1968 (often mis‑dated as 2/24) that Deadheads consider "red‑hot" and essential. Reviewers rave about the eight-song stretch—including The Other One, New Potato Caboose, Born Cross‑Eyed, Spanish Jam, Alligator, Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks), Feedback, and In The Midnight Hour—while noting only a clerical date error; no recording‑quality issues are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Both detailed reviews give 5 stars, praising the musical performance and ignoring any technical flaws, indicating a strong show with at least decent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not comment on sound clarity or mix; no problems were reported, implying the audio is at least listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set of the Carousel Theater show, matching the famed 1/14/68 set two; tight sequencing of jams and rockers makes for a high‑energy flow.
